title: Ann Arbor Overview
intro: My suggested walking route to get a sense of the campus and Ann Arbor itself.

hill.name: Hill dorms (optional)
hill.key: Optional tour of the Hill dorms

extras.name: If you have time / engineering
extras.key: If you have time, or if Will is interested in engineering

places.name: Main Street
places.note: Downtown is the more grown-up part of Ann Arbor. I'd think of it as where you and Caitlin would come if Will ended up going here, or where you'd go if you wanted to take Will out somewhere nicer than a typical college-town restaurant.

places.name: Zingerman's Deli
places.note: The classic Ann Arbor deli. If College GameDay is ever in Ann Arbor, you'll see a shot of Zingerman's.

places.name: East Liberty Street
places.note: The more student-feeling stretch of downtown.

places.name: Modern Languages Building
places.note: A good example of a large lecture hall. This is the kind of classroom where Will might take an intro course like Intro to Psychology.

places.name: Burton Memorial Tower
places.note: The classic college bell tower.

places.name: Michigan League (optional)
places.note: Worth poking your head in if it's open, though I don't really know what the League does or is for.

places.name: Hill Auditorium
places.note: Will will have his freshman welcome here. Peek your head in if it's open.

places.name: The Diag
places.note: This is the block M they'll show on College GameDay. You're not supposed to step on it until you've taken your first exam.

places.name: Angell Hall & the Fishbowl
places.note: Take a look inside. For lack of a better term, it's the heart of LSA, or at least it's representative of the LSA experience.

places.name: Shapiro Library & Hatcher
places.note: If seeing a library is important to Will, check out Shapiro. It's called the UGLi. You can also check out Hatcher, which has the stacks, which I feel like is a quintessential college thing.

places.name: Engineering Arch
places.note: Leave the Diag through the arch under West Hall.

places.name: East Quad
places.note: East Quad has a weird residential program. Unless Will has a very specific vision of never leaving his dorm his freshman year, I wouldn't recommend it.

places.name: Ross School of Business
places.note: The new Ross building, which didn't exist when I was there, is a much, much nicer version of the business school I went to. Note the name of the street.

places.name: Law Quad & Law Library Reading Room
places.note: Go look at the Law Library Reading Room if somebody will let you in. Tell Will he can pretend he's Harry Potter when he studies there.

places.name: Michigan Union
places.note: I don't really know what goes on in the Union, but they do have a bunch of food options in the basement.

places.name: The Cube
places.note: For some unknown reason, this is a Michigan landmark. Go spin it around.

places.name: South State Street
places.note: Walk down South State Street. It borders the campus, with bars and restaurants, and it'll give you a good feel for what it's like walking around the university. You can buy some swag at Rally House.

places.name: Back downtown
places.note: Frita Batidos is just past Main on W Washington if you're hungry.

places.name: Pizza House
places.note: I think I may have eaten more meals at this place than any other restaurant.

places.name: Frita Batidos
places.note: A place that didn't exist when I was here, but I feel like for a version of me 20 years younger, this would be high on my list.

places.name: Blimpy Burger
places.note: A spot that Will should eat at that you should not.

places.name: Fleetwood Diner
places.note: Tiny diner. No chance of getting in there on game day, but maybe try it another day.

places.name: Brown Jug
places.note: If Will went here and was 21, he'd have some hazy memories of this spot.

places.name: Good Time Charley's
places.note: I think the last fight I was in in my life was at Good Time Charley's. See if maybe you guys can start one here on your visit.

places.name: Mr. Spot's
places.note: Will should eat here. You should not.

places.name: Dominick's
places.note: Great place to drink when it's warm out. I can't recall when it closes for the season, so it may be closed when you're there.

places.name: Palmer Field
places.note: The main freshman dorms are all around this field. If Will lives in the dorms freshman year, in all likelihood it'll be one of the ones up here on what's called the Hill.

places.name: Nichols Arboretum (the Arb)
places.note: If it's a really nice day and you have time, it's right next to the Hill dorms, so it's easy to get to from there. You can walk all the way through to the Huron River if you like.

places.name: North Campus (engineering)
places.note: If Will is considering engineering, you need to go up to North Campus. It's a drive up there from Central Campus; you couldn't walk there. Only important to see if Will is going to do engineering or music, I believe. Both are up there, though I don't know North Campus well.
